apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata: {name: harbor-config}
data:
  workers: "4"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: harbor-config-reader}
spec:
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: harbor-service:lab
      imagePullPolicy: Never
      env:
        - name: WORKERS
          valueFrom: {configMapKeyRef: {name: harbor-config, key: workers}}
      volumeMounts:
        - {name: credentials, mountPath: /run/harbor-secrets, readOnly: true}
  volumes:
    - name: credentials
      secret: {secretName: harbor-credentials, defaultMode: 0400}
